pluto.x: Enigmatic megalithic monument carved from water ice discovered at the north pole of Pluto, standing untouched for over a century.
Remote scientific outpost and alien staging ground in Have Space Suit—Will Travel, and fleet monitoring post in Starship Troopers.
Solar System boundary outpost of the invading Gamilas Empire, launching planetary bombs and reflective satellite guns against Earth before being neutralized by the Space Battleship Yamato.
